text:
Avoid combination.

Concomitant use of sertraline (an SSRI) and tramadol increases the risk of developing a potentially life-threatening condition known as serotonin syndrome [sertraline:warnings:9, tramadol:drug_interactions:9]. Additionally, sertraline inhibits the CYP2D6 enzyme [sertraline:drug_interactions:8], which is involved in the metabolism of tramadol [tramadol:clinical_pharmacology:13].
